prompts.level_1: Identify the immediate block, item, entity, movement, inventory, crafting, or interaction goal. Preserve visible target blocks and spatial relations.
prompts.level_2: Summarize the broader building, mining, crafting, exploration, inventory-management, or combat sub-goal without listing every atomic input.
prompts.level_3: State the long-horizon survival, construction, resource-gathering, exploration, or progression objective.
prompts.continuity: Treat consecutive gathering, crafting, travel, and construction steps as continuous only when they support the same larger objective; split on a clear change of project, destination, world state, or session flow.
